'''China Fortune International Trust Co., Ltd.''' known as '''China Fortune Trust''' is a Chinese investment management company which license to create private equity fund (as trust). The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of state-owned [[China Huadian Corporation]].

==History==
China Fortune International Trust Co., Ltd. was re-registered on 24 December 2008, after [[China Huadian Corporation|Huadian]] acquired the license from dormant company Foshan International Trust Investment Co., Ltd.. The company was also relocated from [[Foshan]] to [[Beijing]].{{Citation needed|date=August 2022}}

==Private equity funds==
* Xinbao N°47 Trust: 99.67% stake of Taishan Huacheng Technology (a shareholder of [[Puhua Investment]] and [[Taian Bank]]) as pledge, {{CNY|1.371 billion}} borrowed to Jiexintai.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfitc.com/webfront/fileDownLoad.do?fileId=10231|script-title=zh:华鑫信托·鑫保47号集合资金信托计划|date=2016|access-date=10 February 2017|publisher=China Fortune Investment Trust|language=Chinese}}</ref>
